Extremely bad service that ruins customer anniversaries
Mar 2026 • Couples
The second and a similar mistake compared to the last time, I always booked a table with the same note: "I want to sit next to the table in the inner corner next to the glass door", the last time I ran next to a huge column and didn't meet the glass as I requested, I asked the staff to ask the manager if he had read his reservation before turning out to find a black friend (probably the manager) and then told me I waited about 10p to arrange a table, and then sent me a water voucher to apologize, I was angry but still missed. This time, the order is the same, and put the table in the middle of the path from the direct entrance to the table by the glass, asking if the branch has a problem with understanding?? Or you have to write “corner seat and next to window glass” in English to understand. At the table, there are two tables in the corner, one with an old couple of foreigners sitting, and one with only a woman sitting, so don’t take the reason for booking a similar request or something. Last time it was to ruin a birthday, this time it was an anniversary. Have you asked a manager to exchange more, why exchange more when 2 important occasions were broken by this ***** branch??

Poor customer service
Apr 2025 • Solo
In almost an empty restaurant the waitress refused to let me sit close to the windows (at the pleasant place by daylight) and claimed that only part of the restaurant (nearest to the kitchen, with artificial light) is open. I repeatly asked her if I am not allowed to sit by the windows. She refused again. So I turned and walked away.

There was obviously not any other reason for serving only at some tables than to make the service for the staff as easy as possible, even though serving by the windows would make them walk only about 10 metres more ( If the restaurant would be busy, but there was like 4 guests altogether...)
